title: yes fix

items.content: Mouse scroll must not change selection in any panel; only keys do (FEN6)
Channel to-dos panel: show only active tasks with agent info; completed ones in collapsible task history (RUS197)
Empty channel: ASCII-art channel name plus coordinator welcome message (new agent)
Channel History tab (RUS201 never started; needs a cloud-backed agent)
Root-cause and fix: members created without a cloud machine never start; duplicate sessions; lost messages; red error state. Needs a cloud-backed agent (RUS202 never started)
Older cloud machines: redeploy/update, hub checks tools before ship prompt, hub queues their branches (RUS197)
Plan view header: created when, by whom, for which agent, assignee, machine (RUS199)
Harness bugs: no local fallback when cloud hub is down (duplicate sessions); undeliverable agent messages fail loudly (RUS198)

summary: I split the work across two agents.
